about.metaDescription: Stay.bg is a Bulgarian platform for renting rooms and flats and finding roommates directly, with no agents and no commission.
about.title: About Stay.bg
about.intro: Stay.bg is where people in Bulgaria find a room, let one or find someone to share a home with. You deal with each other directly: no agents in between and no commission on top.

sharing.heading: Life's better when you share it
sharing.p1: Sharing a home is more than splitting the rent. The right roommate is the person you cook with, swap city tips with and sometimes keep as a friend for life.
sharing.p2: That's why Stay.bg is built around people as much as places. Profiles, lifestyle tags and a match score help you find someone whose everyday rhythm fits yours, before you carry a single box up the stairs.
sharing.imageAlt: Café terraces on a cobbled street in Kapana, Plovdiv

mission.heading: Why we built Stay.bg
mission.p1: Finding a room in Bulgaria too often means agency fees, ads that were let weeks ago and phone numbers passed around in crowded groups. People who simply want to rent out a room, or find one, deserve better.
mission.p2: So we built a place where owners and tenants talk to each other directly, where every account confirms its email and where anything suspicious reaches a real team. It's free, it's in Bulgarian and English, and it's made in Bulgaria.

whyUs.metaDescription: Free, direct and built with safety in mind: why renting a room or finding a roommate on Stay.bg is simpler.
whyUs.title: Why use Stay.bg?
whyUs.intro: Finding a room or a roommate is a big decision. Here's how Stay.bg makes it simpler, fairer and safer.

direct.title: Fill a room or find one, without the middleman
direct.body: Post a free listing in a few minutes or start searching straight away. You deal directly with the owner or the people you'd live with, so there's no agency fee and no commission on top of the rent.

you.title: It's all about you
you.body: Everyone wants something different from a shared home. Search by city, neighbourhood, budget and move-in date, then narrow it down to what matters to you: pets allowed, furnished, near the metro, a private bathroom or a women-only household. Add lifestyle tags to your profile and you'll see a match score on listings and people.

safety.title: Safety
safety.body: Every account has to confirm its email address. Phone numbers and emails written in ads and profiles are hidden from visitors who aren't signed in, conversations stay on Stay.bg until you choose to share your details, and messaging limits keep spammers out. Anyone can report or block a listing or user, and our team reviews every report.

meet.title: Meet before you commit
meet.body: Request a viewing from the listing and follow every request under Applied listings. Meet in person, look around and never pay a deposit before you've seen the place. Once you agree, our free rental templates help you put it in writing.

help.title: Help when you need it
help.body: Our FAQs answer the most common questions, our safety tips explain the usual scams, and if you're stuck you can always write to us.

finding.heading: Finding a room or a roommate

find.question: How do I find a room or a compatible roommate on Stay.bg?
find.answer: Choose your city, set your budget and filters, and browse the results or the map. To find a roommate, add a few lifestyle tags to your profile: Stay.bg then shows a match score with each person, so you can message the best fits first.

account.question: Do I need an account to browse?
account.answer: No. Anyone can browse rooms and profiles. You need a free account to message people, save listings and request viewings.

filters.question: Can I look for pet-friendly, smoke-free or LGBTQ+ friendly places and people?
filters.answer: Yes. Listing filters include pets allowed, couples welcome, furnished, a private bathroom, bills or internet included, near the metro and women-only or men-only households. On Find a roommate you can filter people by lifestyle tags, including non-smoker, pet-friendly and LGBTQ+ friendly.

wanted.question: What is a “room wanted” post?
wanted.answer: It's part of your profile. Switch it on in your settings and add your budget, preferred neighbourhoods and move-in date. People with a room can then find you under Find a roommate and message you first.

match.question: How does the match score work?
match.answer: It compares what you and the other side have both filled in, such as lifestyle tags, smoking, pets, budget, area and move-in date. Anything either of you left blank is skipped rather than guessed. It's a guide, not a guarantee, so always meet first.

list.question: How do I list my room?
list.answer: Create a free account and confirm your email, then choose List your property. Add photos, the rent, deposit and bills, the move-in date and a few words about the household. Your listing goes live as soon as you publish it.

cost.question: What does Stay.bg cost?
cost.answer: Nothing. Searching, posting a listing, messaging and requesting viewings are all free, and there's no agency fee or commission. You agree the rent and deposit directly with each other.

address.question: Will people see my exact address?
address.answer: No. The map on your listing shows an approximate area of a few hundred metres, not the building. You decide when to share the exact address, for example when you arrange a viewing.

close.question: What do I do once the room is taken?
close.answer: Archive the listing from My listings. It leaves the search results straight away, so nobody keeps asking about it.

contact.question: How do I contact people without sharing my phone number or email?
contact.answer: Use Stay.bg's messages. Your email is never shown, and your phone number only appears to signed-in users if you switch that on in your settings. Contact details written in ads and profiles are hidden from visitors who aren't signed in.

scams.question: How does Stay.bg protect me from scams?
scams.answer: Every account has to confirm its email address, contact details are hidden from visitors who aren't signed in, and messaging limits keep spammers out. You can report or block any listing or user, and our team reviews every report. The golden rule: never pay anything before you've seen the place and met the person.

report.question: How do I report a listing or a user?
report.answer: Choose Report this listing or Report this user on the listing or profile page and tell us what's wrong. Reports are private: the person isn't told who sent them. You can also block someone so they can no longer message you.

cities.question: Which cities does Stay.bg cover?
cities.answer: Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora, Veliko Tarnovo, Blagoevgrad, Pleven and Haskovo. In Sofia and Plovdiv you can also search neighbourhood by neighbourhood.

language.question: Can I use Stay.bg in English?
language.answer: Yes. The whole site is available in Bulgarian and English: switch languages from the menu at the top.

delete.question: How do I delete my account?
delete.answer: Go to Settings and choose Delete my account. It permanently deletes your account, listings, photos, messages and saved items.
